content.summary: Constructive checks support retaining the precise trace, pool and source-assurance wording. The earlier repairs remain effective; no necessary new repair was found. One optional notation refinement is distinguished below from a requirement. Text-reuse conclusions remain limited to inspected sources.

findings.statement: The conclusion's compressed phrase 'at μ 41' could read 'under μ ≥ 41' for standalone clarity.
findings.disposition: Optional editorial refinement only: Section 3 already defines μ and states the required inequality, so this does not leave a mathematical premise unspecified.

findings.statement: The unchanged text retains attribution and the historical-paper access qualifications checked against the pinned primary source.
findings.disposition: No comprehensive corpus or plagiarism-free claim follows from this bounded review.

revisions.action: Checked current source, identities and CommonMark links.
revisions.result: Spacing and identifier corrections remain resolved; all eight links are intended HTTPS sources.
N[max], μ and N[R] remain distinct and explicit.

checks.method: Read Beta's committed control, independently reconstructed it, and compared Section 3.1 with D19-model-bridge.md Section 2.
checks.observation: The reconstructed 21-member SF4 family has complete root degree19, no sunflower among 1330 member triples, and two completions of trace067. Thus the current count-based wording and binary restriction only for full four-traces are necessary; simplifying proper traces to presence indicators would be wrong. This is not a size68 counterexample.

checks.scope: Constructive compression of the degree17 argument
checks.method: Compared Section 4.4 with D17-P10-ordinary-closure.md and Beta's committed integration observation.
checks.observation: The manuscript correctly names the combined O+H pool as intersecting, then derives P+E≥24. It does not claim all 51 residual members intersect. The opposite I7 support remains arbitrary. Retaining this distinction is preferable to shortening the sentence to an unrestricted residual-family claim.

checks.method: Reread pinned main.tex lines102–128 and manuscript Sections 2 and 7; checked the unchanged manuscript and assigned snapshot commitments.
checks.observation: Historical lower54 attribution remains mediated through the cited preprint. H27 is imported, while the returned-listing discrepancy and unreconstructed historical run remain disclosed. Separate local checks are not promoted to external authentication or Lean closure. Both assigned hashes match; no new text has broadened the previous limited reuse assessment.
